description: This file defines classes related to SubPanel management in SuiteCRM, including aSubPanel and SubPanelDefinitions, handling subpanel loading, layout, ACL checks, and metadata processing.

classes.name: aSubPanel
classes.description: Represents a subpanel instance, handling its loading, layout, data source, and display logic.

classes.name: SubPanelDefinitions
classes.description: Manages collection of subpanel configurations, including layout loading, tab filtering, and access control.

methods.name: buildSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs a search query for a given module using SubPanelSearchForm.

methods.name: isDefaultHidden
methods.description: Checks if the subpanel is set to be hidden by default.

methods.name: distinct_query
methods.description: Determines if the subpanel requires a distinct query.

methods.name: get_title
methods.description: Returns the translated title of the subpanel.

methods.name: get_buttons
methods.description: Retrieves button definitions for the subpanel, with permission-based filtering.

methods.name: load_sub_subpanels
methods.description: Loads sub-subpanels (nested subpanels) based on metadata and ACL.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldsFromCollection
methods.description: Aggregates display fields from a collection of subpanels.

methods.name: isDatasourceFunction
methods.description: Checks if the data source for the subpanel is a function.

methods.name: isCollection
methods.description: Determines if the subpanel is a collection type.

methods.name: get_inst_prop_value
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the instance properties.

methods.name: get_def_prop_value
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the panel definition.

methods.name: get_function_parameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for datasource functions.

methods.name: get_data_source_name
methods.description: Gets the data source name or function for the subpanel.

methods.name: get_where
methods.description: Constructs the WHERE clause for subpanel queries.

methods.name: is_fill_in_additional_fields
methods.description: Checks if additional fields should be filled in.

methods.name: get_list_fields
methods.description: Returns the list fields for the subpanel.

methods.name: get_module_name
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the subpanel.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the subpanel.

methods.name: load_module_info
methods.description: Loads module-specific info like table name and bean instance.

methods.name: get_header_panel_def
methods.description: Returns header panel definition, possibly from sub-subpanels.

methods.name: _to_array
methods.description: Returns an array of the subpanel's current properties.

methods.name: set_panel_definition
methods.description: Sets the panel definition array.

methods.name: get_available_tabs
methods.description: Returns list of subpanel tabs passing ACL and visibility filters.

methods.name: load_subpanel
methods.description: Loads a specific subpanel by name, considering ACL and existence.

methods.name: open_layout_defs
methods.description: Loads layout definitions from metadata files.

methods.name: exclude_tab
methods.description: Removes a tab from the layout and visible list.

methods.name: get_all_subpanels
methods.description: Returns all subpanels across modules, with options for filtering and grouping.

methods.name: set_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Saves hidden subpanels configuration.

methods.name: get_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Retrieves hidden subpanels configuration.
